linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes # (issue)

- [x] Bug fix

- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
When power reboot fails, it could leave the DUT powering back up and taking a few minutes to become healthy again. Meanwhile subsequent test will fail because DUT is unreachable or not healthy.

e.g. when one of the 2 PDU outlet is no longer sending power, DUT is powered by only one outlet, then the sequence of power of all, then power on the no power outlet won't bring DUT back.

#### How did you do it?
1. To avoid the confusion, explicitly turn on all powers in case of test failure and wait for DUT to become healthy again before failing. 
2. Fail power off reboot test directly if any outlet is not providing power.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Run power off reboot test on a DUT with one outlet cable becomes loose (no output power).

With change 1, the test will fail because DUT not coming back. The failure takes a few minutes to timeout and the recover takes another few minutes.

With additional change 2, the test fails quickly.

Signed-off-by: Ying Xie <ying.xie@microsoft.com>
